outline: This is an introductory course of physics for engineers. The goal is to provide the students with the theoretical background and basic case-studies. This includes, electromagnetisms, optical and mechanics. At the same time will include basic modern concepts such as wave-particle duality and atomic and molecular structures as foundations for the following years.
